market_analysis.headline: Iconic high-value chase with strong volume and consistent buyer interest.

demand.explanation: Sustained collector interest keeps it the top card in its set and a modern benchmark even with large available supply. High visibility and appeal support steady buyer activity that prevents deeper drops.

liquidity.explanation: Frequent transactions occur across major platforms with dozens of active listings and multiple sales weekly for both raw and graded copies. High turnover makes entry and exit relatively straightforward for the price level.

stability.explanation: Realized prices cluster in recognizable ranges for raw near mint and PSA 10 but show noticeable spreads and occasional 10-20 percent swings. Consistency is solid for a multi-thousand dollar card yet not tight enough for top marks.

momentum.explanation: Recent movement appears mostly flat to mildly softer across sources with some PSA 10 medians lower and raw holding near prior levels. Evidence points more to sideways action than clear directional strength or weakness.

healthiest_segment.label: PSA 10
healthiest_segment.explanation: Highest sales frequency and clearest pricing consensus among graded copies with strong ongoing volume supporting reliable transactions.

market_balance.label: balanced
market_balance.explanation: Ample listings and high graded population give buyers options while persistent demand prevents heavy discounts. Raw near mint and PSA 10 both clear regularly without strong one-sided pressure.

price_discovery.label: strong
price_discovery.explanation: Numerous recent sales and multiple tracking sources produce overlapping ranges for raw near mint around two thousand and PSA 10 near four thousand. Agreement is good enough for confident current fair value reads on both raw and graded.

eyes_on.label: PSA 10 supply absorption and raw-to-grade spreads
eyes_on.explanation: Watch whether the large gem population continues to be absorbed at current levels and how the premium over raw near mint evolves with ongoing submissions.

near_term.label: stable
near_term.explanation: Current volume and demand levels support sideways trading without clear catalysts for sharp moves in either direction over the next months.

long_term.label: positive
long_term.explanation: Enduring popularity of the artwork and character plus its status as a modern benchmark should support values as the set ages further out of print.

upside_drivers: Persistent collector demand for the iconic alternate art
Limited risk of direct reprint for this exact version
risks: Continued high PSA 10 population adding supply pressure
Attention shifting to newer chase cards

reasoning: This card carries strong collector demand as one of the most recognized alternate arts from the Sword and Shield era, often called Moonbreon, which supports steady sales volume across raw and graded copies. Liquidity is solid with multiple sales per week even at higher price points.

The very high PSA population, especially the large share of PSA 10s near 70 percent of graded copies, reduces scarcity premiums for top grades and increases competition when selling. Modern holofoil cards can show surface or centering issues that make consistent high grades less certain without close inspection.

Faster PSA tiers are available and open, avoiding the longest backlogs, though overall submission volume at PSA remains elevated. Relative to other Pokemon cards the combination of popularity and population density places the score in the middle range.

variants.headline: Popular Moonbreon alt art with solid demand but high PSA 10 population limits edge outside top grade
variants.bottom_line: Grading produces meaningful paper profit mainly when the card returns as PSA 10. Lower grades show limited or negative incremental results after fees and costs, so submission is most reasonable for copies that appear strong candidates for the top grade after careful review.

risk_profile.label: high
risk_profile.explanation: The large existing PSA population, particularly the high share of PSA 10s, creates more supply pressure than for scarcer modern cards. Condition sensitivity on holofoil surfaces and centering can lead to grades below expectations more often than average, and the paper profit gap between PSA 9 and PSA 10 is wide.

analyses.verdict: The definitive modern grail card known as Moonbreon for serious collectors.
analyses.overview: This alternate art secret rare Umbreon VMAX stands as the premier chase card and cultural icon of the Sword & Shield era and Evolving Skies set. Nicknamed Moonbreon by the community, it represents the pinnacle of modern Pokémon TCG collecting due to its status as the most coveted single from its generation.

categories.name: Rarity & Scarcity
categories.text: As a secret rare alternate art numbered 215/203 beyond the main set, it features a notably low pull rate estimated around 1 in 400-750 packs from Evolving Skies boosters. The set has long been out of print with no major reprints of the singles, and while overall print runs for Sword & Shield were substantial, the combination of secret rare status and extreme demand has kept high-grade raw and graded copies relatively scarce on the secondary market. No reverse holofoil or other special patterns exist for this printing.

categories.name: Collectors Demand
categories.text: Demand is exceptionally high and consistent across casual fans, Eeveelution specialists, alt art collectors, and investors. It is widely regarded as the most popular and sought-after card in Evolving Skies and arguably the entire Sword & Shield series, frequently topping want lists, master set priorities, and graded population discussions. The organic 'Moonbreon' nickname underscores its cultural penetration within the hobby, driving perpetual interest years after release.

categories.name: Significance
categories.text: This card defines the Evolving Skies set and serves as the flagship example of the alternate art secret rare format that elevated modern Pokémon TCG collecting. Released in August 2021, it quickly became the most valuable Sword & Shield era card and a benchmark for modern chase cards. Its role in completing Eeveelution alt art collections and its status as a blue-chip modern piece give it outsized historical importance within the hobby.

categories.name: Artwork & Aesthetics
categories.text: Illustrated by KEIICHIRO ITO, the full-bleed alternate art depicts Dynamax Umbreon in a serene yet powerful nighttime rooftop scene under a prominent full moon, with glowing golden rings contrasting cool blues and city lights below. The atmospheric, story-driven composition—evoking guardianship and moonlight lore tied to Umbreon—elevates it far beyond standard portraits, with textured holofoil enhancing the moonlight and depth. It is frequently praised as one of the finest modern Pokémon card illustrations.

categories.name: Long-Term Collectibility
categories.text: As a proven modern blue-chip card that has maintained strong value through market cycles, it offers excellent long-term prospects for both display and investment-oriented collections. Its iconic status, fan-favorite Pokémon, masterpiece artwork, and position as the SWSH era's top card ensure enduring appeal among future generations of collectors. Graded high-end copies (especially PSA/BGS 10) command significant premiums and liquidity, fitting perfectly into master sets, Eeveelution binders, or standalone grail displays.

finalNote: This Holofoil is the sole English printing of the Umbreon VMAX Alternate Art Secret Rare (215/203) from Evolving Skies; there are no reverse holos, pattern variants, 1st Edition distinctions, or other English finishes for this specific card. Identification is straightforward via the card number 215/203, full-bleed alternate artwork by KEIICHIRO ITO showing the moonlit rooftop scene, secret rare holofoil texture, and lack of a standard yellow border. It is universally known in the community as Moonbreon.

In the broader collecting hobby, this card anchors Evolving Skies master sets (where it often represents a large portion of the total value), completes the highly desirable Eeveelution VMAX alternate art suite, and serves as a cornerstone modern grail comparable to classic chase cards in earlier eras. Its combination of scarcity relative to demand, artistic excellence, and cultural nickname cements its place as a must-have for serious Pokémon collectors focused on modern or character-specific collections. High-grade examples are particularly prized for long-term holding and display.
